paragraphs: OpenAI GPT is the family of models OpenAI develops and offers. OpenAI says GPT-5.5 is its smartest and most intuitive to use model yet, and that it excels at writing and debugging code, researching online, analyzing data, creating documents and spreadsheets, operating software, and moving across tools until a task is finished. OpenAI says GPT-5.6 Sol sets a new standard for both intelligence and efficiency, and that GPT-6 Astra is the most intelligent and aligned model in the world.

The family is organised into versions and sizes. GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro were released in April 2026. The GPT-5.6 family followed in July 2026 with Sol, Terra, and Luna. GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna were introduced alongside GPT-6 Astra, and GPT-6.1 Sol is an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol. OpenAI offers the models in ChatGPT and Codex, and through the API. GPT-5.5 rolled out to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in ChatGPT and Codex, and GPT-5.5 Pro to Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in ChatGPT. OpenAI says GPT-6 Sol and Luna reduce API prices by 50% compared with their GPT-5.6 promotional pricing.

price_limits.summary: Across the 56 versions, input prices run from $0.02 to $30 per million tokens and output prices from $0.09 to $180. gpt-oss-20b is the cheapest, at $0.02 per million input tokens and $0.09 per million output tokens. GPT-6.1 Sol Pro has the largest context window, 1,050,000 tokens.

family_reading.text: OpenAI GPT spans 56 versions, and the whole family shows 38 of them supporting reasoning, 3 publishing open weights, and context windows from 4095 to 1050000 tokens. Inputs cover audio, image and text, outputs cover audio, image and text. The newest versions reach 1050000 token context and 128000 token output, with prices from $0.1 per million input and $0.5 output at the low end up to $30 input and $180 output at the high end. A LiveBench leaderboard row names GPT-5.6 Sol at 82.4. These facts suggest the family suits long document, audio and image work where reasoning matters, with cheap tiers for volume and costly tiers for demanding jobs. Limits are that most versions are API only, only 3 publish open weights, and top tiers are expensive.
